context:
Goal: design work gets enough thought without paying for it twice.
Problem (rule): you asked "should both design reviewer and designer be opus high? or should one be pegged down a notch?" Main runs both on Opus high.
Based on (read): the retrospective's take: the designer keeps Opus high (a wide design space); the design reviewer drops to Opus medium (it judges against a mockup and the repo's design rules). Unmeasured.
Departs from: main, where both run Opus high — option a lowers the design reviewer.
Meanwhile: both keep Opus high.

lastAnswer.note: for design reviewer move it to sonnet high (typed to the retrospective 14:01 CST, relayed)

options.gain: Saves on the judging role, keeps depth where the design is drawn.
options.label: Designer Opus high, design reviewer Opus medium (recommended)
options.lose: A shallower review may miss a flaw in a screen (unmeasured).

options.gain: No change; both roles get full depth.
options.label: Both Opus high

reply: Filed 14:0x CST: your words are ruling own-756-design-reviewer-sonnet. The design reviewer moves to Sonnet high; the designer stays Opus high. Step model-layout-to-table lands it.
short: Designer and design reviewer: both Opus high, or one lower?
title: Should the designer and the design reviewer both run Opus high, or should one go down a notch?
why: It changes two ruled agent rows.
